question.prompt: Point \(P\) lies on the graph of the inverse proportional function \(y=-8/x\). \(PA\) is perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis at \(A\), and \(PB\) is perpendicular to the \(y\)-axis at \(B\). Find the area of rectangle \(OAPB\).

solutions.explanation: The area of the rectangle equals the product of the absolute values of the coordinates of \(P\), namely \(|k|=|-8|=8\).
solutions.title: Use the geometric meaning of k
